fusions.name: Mana Exhaust
fusions.desc: Vents 3 bolts of raw mana from your exhaust at once, spread apart; each deals 9 damage and knocks what it hits back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Unspent Fuel
fusions.desc: Fires the arcana left in your tank into the first enemy in its path. It deals 20 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target for 60% more damage each.

fusions.name: Topping the Tank
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Mana-Fed Engine
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, you regain 6 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
